scoring.candidate_rule: Sniper BUY/SELL on D0/D1/D2 only AND trade_setup must still be ACTIVE; STOPPED/COMPLETED setups are excluded from fresh candidates. D0=FRESH, D1=RECENT_REVALIDATE, D2=AGING_REVALIDATE.
scoring.actionability_rule: D1/D2 remain discovery-eligible only while ACTIVE; current displacement from original entry, remaining distance to TP1, invalidation distance and remaining R:R to TP1 are exported for report-time revalidation.
scoring.strong_signal_rule: score>=85 + JOAT CONFIRM @ Sniper signal + current Sniper alignment + supportive niche
scoring.niche_method: GICS sub-industry technical basket when >=3 members, else GICS sector basket; 100% price/volume technical context
